records.title: Fuel oil from two wrecked tankers fouls the Kerch Strait, Anapa and Crimea coasts, and a federal emergency follows
records.description: Two Russian fuel-oil tankers, Volgoneft-212 and Volgoneft-239, wrecked in the Kerch Strait on 15 December 2024 and spilled about 2,400 tonnes of fuel oil according to Russia's Transport Ministry. Fuel oil reached the Anapa and Temryuk coasts and Crimea, regional and federal emergencies were declared, and Rospotrebnadzor declared 141 Anapa beaches and nine in Temryuk district unsuitable for recreation. By August 2026 pumping of fuel oil from the sunken tanker sections was reported complete, 111 Anapa beaches had received Rospotrebnadzor approval documents, Rosprirodnadzor put the environmental damage at about 84.9 billion rubles in claims against the two owners, of which a Kuban court ordered 49.46 billion rubles to be paid for the Volgoneft-212 in August 2025. After two tankers were damaged in a storm in the Kerch Strait on 14 December 2024, the Delfa Dolphin Rescue and Research Center reported 32 dolphin deaths it said were most likely related to the fuel-oil spill, most of them endangered Azov harbour porpoises. Russian authorities said up to 200,000 tons of soil may have been contaminated, and Rospotrebnadzor declared 141 Anapa beaches unfit for recreation, a status its head said still applied in February 2026. Local reports in March 2026 described dead birds and dolphins left uncollected on Anapa beaches.

records.title: Microplastics trapped in Posidonia seagrass balls at four Tunisian beaches
records.description: A peer-reviewed Frontiers in Marine Science study sampled Posidonia oceanica fibre balls (aegagropiles) at Bizerte, Hammamet, Mahdia and Chebba and found microplastics at all four sites. Red and blue particles dominated, with black fibres and fragments the most common forms, and polystyrene, EVA, PET and PVC were identified. The authors link the contamination to local human activity and call for continued monitoring.

records.description: INA completed the Ana-4 DIR gas well in the northern Adriatic in July 2026, the first of five wells in a EUR 65 million campaign (OE Digital), and Il Nord Est reports a EUR 86 million plan for three new wells to be completed by end 2026. records.title: Floating wind in the Sicily Channel: first Italian approval for 7SeasMed after regional objections, and a 1.14 GW project filed
records.description: In 2022 the Sicilian Regional Assembly environment committee opposed floating wind projects west of the Egadi Islands, citing archaeology, fishing and shipping. In March 2024 the Italian environment ministry approved the environmental impact assessment for 7SeasMed, a 250 MW floating farm about 32 km off Marsala. In May 2026 a consortium of Oxan Energy, Ingka Investments and Avapa Energy filed an assessment application for a 1.14 GW project, Dentice, 22 to 40 km off the southern Sicilian coast near Agrigento; Italian press reported it in late June 2026.
